kind: pre-registration of a probe of trained models, no training; on the server's CPU
why: The stack's long written chains break where the assignment that a step needs stands more than about 150 bytes back in the stream: practice_cap_raised.json diagnostic_where_chains_break finds 16.1% of such steps wrong at 20 hops with the cap at 8, against at most 1.7% nearer and 1.2% for the Transformer. And the stack's state reads learned offsets for the age of a cell that turn negative at 121 bytes and are lowest at 140 to 150 bytes, where the line before ends in the corpus (diagnostic_age_offsets). Both point to recall by age, but both come from long chains, where a model also reads the chain it has written itself. This probe asks the question alone: does a model recall one binding that stands a given number of bytes back, when only other assignments stand between? Lines of 36 assignments put bindings 150 to 200 bytes back inside the line itself; lines of 24 assignments are the corpus's own, and the two at the same distance tell what a longer line costs apart from the distance.
tasks: experiments/recall_over_distance.py (this commit). Lines of 24 and of 36 assignments drawn as experiments/hop_tasks.py draws them, each with a query of one hop. In every line the query's assignment is moved to a place drawn among those whose distance back from the end of the prompt (the query's '=', where the answer is written) lies in a band of 25 bytes, the distance counted from the assignment's first byte as in experiments/where_chains_break.py; the other assignments keep their order, and a line with no place in the band is drawn again. Bands: 0-25 to 125-150 bytes in lines of 24 assignments (prompts of 131 to 141 bytes), 0-25 to 200-225 in lines of 36 (199 to 208 bytes); the farthest band of each holds only a line's first assignment or two. 200 lines a band and length from seed 0, the same lines for every model. Every answer is written greedily with room for 16 bytes in a stream of its own from an empty state, led by newlines to the length of the band's longest prompt (experiments/practice_loop.py attempts, as every evaluation of the practice loop runs), and is right if the last byte before the newline is the query's digit (practice_loop.grade).
models: Bases: chain-stack and chain-tf (written_chains.json: the written hop corpus of 1 to 4 hops), four-stack (written_chains_four_families.json) and four-tf-chain (four_families_transformer_again.json), their averaged weights. Practised (practice_cap_raised.json): r8-stack-s0, -s1, -s2, r12-stack-s0, -s1, -s2, r16-stack-s0, -s1, -s2 and r8-tf-s0, -s1, -s2, their models after 2,000 rounds. The Transformer's runs with the cap at 12 and 16, which run in this weekend's window, are added by amendment before they are probed. The Transformer reads windows of 256 bytes, and every prompt with its answer fits in one (at most 208 and 16 bytes).
code: The server's code copy v18q (= d0f53e2) for the models and the practice loop, with experiments/recall_over_distance.py of this commit, on the server's CPU (nice, cores 8 to 31, no GPU).
measure: For every model, line length and band: the right answers of 200, the accuracy with its 95% Wilson interval, the share of answers that are one digit and a newline, the mean bytes, the mean distance.

reading.(1): Recall falls with distance for a model if, in lines of 36 assignments, its accuracy in the band 150-175 and in the band 175-200 is each at least 0.10 below its accuracy over the four bands from 0 to 100 bytes (800 tasks), with the two 95% intervals apart. Read for every model.
reading.(2): The stack against the Transformer, band by band in lines of 36 assignments, for chain-stack against chain-tf, four-stack against four-tf-chain, and each seed of r8-stack against the r8-tf run of the same seed: one recalls better in a band if its accuracy is at least 0.10 higher with the intervals apart.
reading.(3): What a longer line costs apart from distance: for every model, its accuracy over the five bands from 0 to 125 bytes (1,000 tasks) in lines of 24 assignments against lines of 36; the longer line costs recall if the shorter line's accuracy is at least 0.05 higher with the intervals apart.
reading.(4): Where recall starts to fall, for every model whose recall falls by (1): the first band in lines of 36 assignments whose accuracy is at least 0.10 below its accuracy over 0 to 100 bytes with the intervals apart, reported beside the age from which its offsets stay below zero (121 bytes for chain-stack and every practised stack, 129 for four-stack).
reading.reported and not read: Every cell; the share of answers in the form of one digit and a newline; the mean bytes; the farthest band of each line length, which holds only a line's first assignments.
reading.scope: Synthetic lookups that ask for one binding: what each model's memory reaches, not a claim about reasoning in language.

what follows: If recall falls with distance for chain-stack and four-stack and not for chain-tf and four-tf-chain, and (3) does not put it down to the longer line, the next registration gives the stack's state reads a clock that beats at the start of every line, so that each head has an offset for the present line and for the line before beside its offsets for the age in bytes (the read's beats, which can count words, counting lines), and asks whether a stack trained with it recalls at every distance within its window and writes long chains whole further; this probe and diagnostic_where_chains_break's measure are its measures. If (3) finds that the longer line costs recall as well, the clock is still the next registration, and the probe's lines of 24 assignments are its reference. If the stack's recall does not fall with distance, one binding is recalled at any distance within the read's window, the long chains break by something else, most likely the chain a model writes itself, and the next probe places a written chain between the binding and the query.
seen_before_recording: practice_cap_raised.json's two diagnostics (where the chains break, the age offsets); the task drawing alone, 20 lines a band with another seed (their distances and prompt lengths, no model); a smoke test of the script with 2 lines a band from chain-stack and chain-tf on the laptop's CPU with seed 99, of which only that every cell was written was looked at. No model has answered a line of this probe's seed.
